# Real Section

An HTML block opener indented past CommonMark's three-space cap still interrupts an OPEN
paragraph, because pandoc's html-block rule never looks at the indent. Every construct in
this fixture is pressed directly against prose on purpose: with a blank line above it the
same line would be an indented code block, and the heading below would be real for a
reason that has nothing to do with what this fixture is pinning.

below it is not a heading at all. The tag decides, exactly as it does at column zero.

the block rather than opening a paragraph.

# Not A Heading — Line Block In A Paragraph

A pipe table's body row is spelled like a line-block line, but the delimiter row makes it
a table, and a continuation-shaped line under a table is ordinary paragraph text.
